act-move-stroke-test-sop: What and why

The stroke test is the standard 5-minute hand pump discharge test that estimates how much water a pump delivers per stroke (parameter SDWS 28 in methodology v2.0). Version 2.2 of the standard operating procedure (SOP), in French and English, supersedes v2.1 and records James Walker's answers of 18 and 21 September 2026.
Decision for Adriaan: Approve stroke-test SOP v2.2 (French and English) as the procedure of record.
Options:
1. Approve as it stands
2. Approve with named changes
3. Hold until James Walker signs

Recommendation: Approve as it stands: v2.2 already records James's answers of 18 and 21 Sep 2026 (SDWS 28 Option 3). After approval Claude moves the French file from Work in Progress to SOPs and marks v2.1 and v2.0 retired.
What to deliver
v2.2 signed off, French and English.
Both filed in Central Data Hub, Water Documents, SOPs.
v2.1 and v2.0 marked retired.
Closes when: The signed stroke-test SOP v2.2, French and English, is filed in Water Documents/SOPs and v2.1 and v2.0 are retired.

act-fluoride-five-pumps-status: What and why

Five hand pumps in Ambinanitelo, Maroantsetra district (800634100, 797195318, 794012210, 797195301, 797885233), were tested for fluoride on 15 Aug 2025 for the commissioning check (SDWS 3). Cathy confirmed on 7 Oct 2026 that the reading recorded as 1.5 mg/L was above the range of the test, so fluoride was more than 1.5 mg/L, which is the World Health Organization (WHO) guideline value.
Decision for Adriaan: Decide how the five Ambinanitelo pumps with fluoride above 1.5 mg/L count in the SDWS 3 safe-water check.
Options:
1. Exclude them from the safe-water count until a valid result (Institut Pasteur)
2. Keep them counted pending a retest
3. Count them on the diluted results (act-fluoride-diluted-results)
Recommendation: Exclude them until a valid result: it is the conservative reading a verifier expects, and MadAvance and the communities are told what the WHO guideline means for them.
What to deliver
A decision: exclude the five pumps from the SDWS 3 safe water count until the Institut Pasteur (Part B) result is in, or another treatment agreed with James.
A decision on informing MadAvance and the communities served.
Closes when: the decision is recorded and passed to James (VPA-DD) and Angelo (MadAvance).
